product_metadata.title: allydrew Large Foldable Tote Nylon Reusable Grocery Bag
features: PROMOTES GREEN LIFESTYLE. Reduces trash from unwanted plastic bags, helps protect the environment and wildlife. These reusable bags can be used again and again.
FOLDABLE. The reusable bags can be folded into a tiny inner pocket that can conveniently fit in your purse. Great for taking with you anywhere you want.
SET INCLUDES 2 BAGS: Large: 22 x 16.5 inches, 9 inch handles. Small: 14 x 15 inches, 8.5 inch handles.
DURABLE: Lightweight yet very wear-resistant and does not rip easily. Made with nylon. Holds up to 44 lbs. Waterproof.
USE: For carrying groceries, shopping, traveling and storage. Can also be used as a book bag or lunch bag.
description: Reusable bags are a fun and fashionable alternative to one-time-use bags. Be kind to the environment by using our reusable nylon bags instead. The set of 2 includes a large and small bag. The large bag allows you to carry more than the average grocery bag; use the bag for shopping, while traveling or for storage. The small bag makes a convenient book bag and lunch bag. Both bags are super durable and can carry up to 44 pounds. These reusable bags can be folded into an inner pocket and stored conveniently away when not in use. Available in a variety of patterns that will make carrying your bags around enjoyable.
